info.title: Ritten
info.description: A command line tool for running portable CI/CD workflows.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Compiles and tests, without any release checks.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show every log entry in its highest detail.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Show each step's outcome, but only failure detail.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Rehearse the job without pushing, tagging, releasing, or commenting.

options.name: --auto-approve
options.description: Approve a job up front, for runs with nobody there to confirm.
